faqHome.title: FAQ
faqHome.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our products and ordering.
faqHome.helpText: Still have questions? Our team is happy to help anytime.
faqHome.q1: How do I order SAMAQU products?
faqHome.a1: Choose a product from the catalog, check the size guide, then tap the WhatsApp button to contact our admin. They'll help with availability confirmation through to payment.
faqHome.q2: Are SAMAQU materials comfortable and breathable?
faqHome.a2: Absolutely. We select quality materials that are cool, lightweight, and breathable — comfortable for worship, daily wear, or special occasions for extended periods.
faqHome.q3: What if I'm unsure about choosing the right size?
faqHome.a3: Use our size guide as a starting point. If you're still unsure, simply chat with our admin mentioning your height and body type — we'll help find the best-fitting size.
faqHome.q4: Can I place bulk or wholesale orders?
faqHome.a4: Of course. We serve personal, family, and community orders. For wholesale purchases, special pricing is available — share your needs and our team will put together the best deal.
faqHome.q5: Is there a warranty on the products?
faqHome.a5: Every product goes through stitching and material checks before shipping. If there's any issue with your order, contact our admin and we'll help resolve it wholeheartedly.

samaQuran.heroDesc: A value we hope to carry for a lifetime.
samaQuran.maknaDesc1: For us, being with the Quran is not about memorizing 30 juz, 20 juz, or even 10 juz.
samaQuran.maknaDesc2: Sama Quran is about making the Quran a part of our life.
samaQuran.maknaClosing: You don't have to wait until you're perfect to start being with the Quran.
samaQuran.perjalananTitle:
Whatever Your Journey,

Stay With the Quran.
samaQuran.perjalananDesc1: We are all walking a different journey.
samaQuran.perjalananDesc2: Some are studying, working, building dreams, bettering themselves, or trying to mend a life that feels heavy.
samaQuran.perjalananDesc3: But whatever it is, one thing must never be left behind: never let the journey take us away from the Quran.
samaQuran.perjalananQuote: Because in the end, it is not only about how we live our life. It is also about how we close it.
samaQuran.hidupTitle:
Live with the Quran.
Return with the Quran.
samaQuran.hidupDesc1: That is the hope we carry through the name Samaqu.
samaQuran.hidupDesc2: May Sama Quran be more than a brand name — may it be a value that lives within us, and within anyone who wishes to carry it.
samaQuran.hidupDesc3: We want this value to be preserved not only through what we say, but through what we do.
samaQuran.ctaDesc: Living with it. And hoping to return with it.

garansiRetur.heroDesc: We understand that buying clothes online can sometimes make us hesitant.
garansiRetur.heroBullet1: What if the size doesn't fit?
garansiRetur.heroBullet2: What if the item received doesn't match?
garansiRetur.heroBullet3: Or what if there's a shipping error?
garansiRetur.heroClosing: That's why we're committed to providing a comfortable and safe shopping experience. If any issues arise that are our responsibility, we'll help resolve them as best we can.
garansiRetur.garansiDesc: We provide warranty for the following conditions.
garansiRetur.garansi1Desc: For example, the product, color, or size received doesn't match your order. We'll exchange it at no additional cost.
garansiRetur.garansi2Desc: If there are manufacturing defects that passed Quality Control, we'll inspect and assist with the exchange process according to applicable terms.
garansiRetur.garansi2Note: Shipping costs fully covered by SAMAQU.
garansiRetur.garansi3Desc: If the size received doesn't match what was ordered, we'll help with the size exchange process as long as stock is available.
garansiRetur.garansi3Note: Shipping costs borne by the buyer.
garansiRetur.returDesc: To ensure the return process goes smoothly, please make sure the following requirements are met.
garansiRetur.retur1: Product has never been used or washed.
garansiRetur.retur2: Labels and tags are still intact.
garansiRetur.retur4: Request submitted within 3 days of receiving the product.
garansiRetur.cara2: Explain the issue and include photos or videos as evidence.
garansiRetur.cara3: Our team will inspect and provide the best solution.
garansiRetur.cara4: If approved, we'll provide product shipping instructions.
garansiRetur.noReturDesc: To maintain product quality for all customers, we cannot accept returns for the following conditions.
garansiRetur.noRetur3: Wrong size due to not following the size guide
garansiRetur.noRetur4: Product has been used or washed
garansiRetur.ctaDesc1: If you still have questions about warranty or returns, don't hesitate to contact our team. We'll be happy to help.
garansiRetur.ctaDesc2: Because for us, your satisfaction and comfort are an important part of the SAMAQU journey.

createYourPrice.heroSubtitle: At SAMAQU, you can choose your own price.
createYourPrice.storyTitle: We know what it's like to love quality products, but have to give up on them.
createYourPrice.storyP1: Not because we don't want to buy them. But because there are many other things more important to fight for.
createYourPrice.storyP2: We understand that, because SAMAQU was also born from ordinary people. That's why we created Create Your Price.
createYourPrice.accessTitle: Good quality should be accessible to more people.
createYourPrice.accessP1: We want to create products with quality we're truly proud of, without making the price feel burdensome.
createYourPrice.accessP2: Because everyone's ability is different. A price that feels light to someone can be a big expense for another.
createYourPrice.accessP3: We don't want that difference to become a barrier to accessing quality products.
createYourPrice.howTitle: How does Create Your Price work?
createYourPrice.step1Desc: Every SAMAQU product has a clearly stated Minimum Price.
createYourPrice.step2Desc: You're free to decide the price you want to pay, as long as it's not below the Minimum Price.
createYourPrice.step3Desc: No matter what price you choose, the product and quality you receive remain the same.
createYourPrice.simNoteMin: Rp300,000 is a valid choice. No need to feel hesitant — that's exactly why we created our Minimum Price.
createYourPrice.simNoteAbove: Thank you. The price you choose helps us keep the Minimum Price affordable for more people. The product you receive stays the same.
createYourPrice.minTitle: Can I choose the Minimum Price?
createYourPrice.minP1: If Rp300,000 is the price that best fits your current ability, go ahead and choose Rp300,000. No need to feel hesitant.
createYourPrice.minP2: That's exactly why we created the Minimum Price. And no matter what price you choose, the product and quality you receive remain the same.
createYourPrice.notDiscountTitle: Not a discount. Not a promo.
createYourPrice.notDiscountP1: Create Your Price is not a temporary program. It's SAMAQU's way of making good quality more accessible to ordinary people like us.
createYourPrice.notDiscountP2: We want to grow without leaving behind those we've wanted to serve from the start.
createYourPrice.notDiscountP3: Even as SAMAQU grows bigger, our hope isn't to make products harder to reach. Rather, to make the Minimum Price more accessible to more people.
createYourPrice.closingText: Because our abilities may differ. But good quality should be experienced by more people.
createYourPrice.closingCta: Create Your Price — Choose Your Best Price
